name: STORM with SVRG epoch anchor
tagline: STORM-style recursive estimator initialised at every epoch by the full gradient anchor, with adaptive step size and gradient clipping.

key_hyperparams.name: epoch_anchor
key_hyperparams.role: reset d to full gradient each epoch

init_recovers: STORM at a_max→1; SVRG-anchor when no recursive update happens
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of the SVRG and STORM baselines: keeps STORM's recursive d update inside the epoch, but at every epoch boundary resets d to a freshly-computed full gradient (SVRG anchor); also adds a clip+adaptive-step layer on top.

name: SVRG with loss-type momentum + clipping
tagline: Standard SVRG control-variate estimator, but momentum=0.9 only for cross-entropy (off for MSE) plus aggressive grad clipping for regression.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a loss-type-conditional Polyak momentum and a periodically-refreshed LARS-style trust scale on top of SVRG (matches the SVRG baseline exactly when loss=mse and momentum=0); MSE branch additionally hard-clips v.

name: SVRG estimator + Adam/LAMB step
tagline: Replaces SVRG's plain SGD step with an Adam-style m,v update on the SVRG-corrected gradient and a LAMB trust-ratio cap on the global step.
diff_from_baseline: Keeps the SVRG estimator but feeds it through an Adam moment update (rather than vanilla SGD) and tops the global step with a LAMB-style trust ratio — neither component appears in svrg/storm/storm_plus baselines.

name: Dual control-variate (SARAH + SVRG anchor)
tagline: Maintains a SARAH/STORM recursive estimator and an SVRG anchor estimator simultaneously, blends them by a confidence score from their disagreement.
init_recovers: SVRG when mix=0; SARAH/STORM when mix=1
diff_from_baseline: Combines the SVRG and STORM baselines by computing both estimators every step and convex-blending them by an agreement-based confidence — a dual control-variate construction that none of svrg/storm/storm_plus baselines do.

name: STORM with cosine-quality momentum
tagline: Single full-gradient init, then STORM updates whose momentum is gated by the cosine alignment between the previous estimator and the new stochastic gradient.
diff_from_baseline: Builds on STORM by multiplicatively modulating the momentum coefficient by the absolute cosine alignment between $d_{t-1}$ and $g_t$ (floored at 80 %), and computes the full gradient only once at training start (vs SVRG which does it every epoch).
